meta_description: 8,014 likes, 36 comments - cntraveler on October 29, 2026: "Edinburgh is a city of contrasts—grand yet familiar, ancient yet constantly evolving, captured here by @rishmakhadka. In recent years, the city has welcomed a wave of new openings that sit comfortably alongside heritage favorites, offering visitors more choice than ever before. Some lean into the city’s dramatic history, with richly layered interiors and period architecture, while others embrace a sleeker, more contemporary edge. Many come with rooftop bars, whisky-stocked lounges, and front-row views of the castle or the Firth of Forth. At the link in bio, @rosieconroy1 shares the best of them, whether you're coming to town for the festivals, food, or just a weekend of wandering.".
